title: All the Small Things

patterns.chug: D D D D D D D D
patterns.pm: M M M M M M M M

verse.name: Verse
verse.cue: Palm mute: hand on the bridge

chorus.name: Chorus
chorus.cue: Lift your hand: let it ring out

outro.name: Outro
outro.cue: Stop dead on the last hit

notes: Four power chords, one bar each, nearly the whole way through: C5, G5, F5, G5. The same shape moves between the A and low E strings. Palm-mute the verses (PM): rest the side of your hand on the strings by the bridge, then lift it off for a big, open chorus. Keep the down-strokes even and don't speed up. The bridge changes the order; learn it from Songsterr once this feels easy.
